messages:
oliver: Quick sync — I'm trying to get nova-9b into staging for a Dedicated-only trial. Need a fast gate check: where to point weights, any tokenizer quirks we should patch, and whether license + attribution text blocks us from offering this on Hosted. weights currently at s3://models/nova/9b/v1/ (uploaded yesterday).

rebecca: Heads-up — that S3 path looks like a temp upload. Canonical path should be s3://model-registry/nova/9b/weights-2026-03-10.tar.gz and include checksums (sha256.txt). Also confirm there's a shard-index.json alongside the tarball otherwise the serving layer won't find sharded shards.

jai: Quick tokenizer note: this model's tokenizer was converted from a legacy byte-bpe. The conversion left the special instruction token <|inst|> mapped to id 50256 which collides with our stop token convention. If we don't remap, prompts with tool-calling may truncate. I tried a local decode and got weird truncation on "</s>" sequences.

anya: Legal quick check: model card includes "CC BY-NC 4.0" in the license section and a paragraph asking for attribution in outputs. CC BY-NC disallows commercial use — that prevents hosting in our public Hosted tier unless we obtain an explicit commercial license from the rights holder. Dedicated or private deployments are fine provided contract has proper liability clauses. Please attach full license text + provenance for weights.

oliver: Got it. My intention was to make this Dedicated-only initially. Will make Hosted opt-out for now. Two asks before I proceed: (1) exact path to put final weights and checksum file, (2) recommended tokenizer fix (remap id or change stop token) and a small config diff I can patch.

rebecca: Use s3://model-registry/nova/9b/weights-2026-03-10.tar.gz and add weights-2026-03-10.sha256 with the checksum. Also add manifest.json with keys: {"shards": N, "format": "tar", "created_by": "ingest-bot"}. For runtime hints, include runtime.hints: {"preferred_dtype": "fp16", "kv_cache_dtype": "int32"}.

jai: For tokenizer, simplest safe patch: remap <|inst|> to a high unused id (e.g., 320000) and update tokenizer.json/vocab accordingly. If you don't want id changes, adjust model_config.yaml to treat 50256 as a reserved stop token so we don't use it for instruction delimiting. Example snippet I tested: ```yaml
tokenizer_overrides:
  reserved_ids:
    inst_token: 320000
    stop_token: 50256
```

sre-oncall: Also flagging runtime limits — on A100-40GB default batch_size=8 OOMs for long-context (8k) requests. For staging canary use batch_size=4, kv_eviction: aggressive. Routing note: pin to dedicated pool with 1 replica until we confirm sharding works.

legal-bot: From legal ops: to allow Hosted we need either (a) a commercial license from the model creator, or (b) an exception approval (rare). We can enable Dedicated if ingesters attest to training data provenance and we embed the following attribution header in the model card and API responses: 

"Model: Nova-9B (v1) — Attribution required per CC BY-NC 4.0. See /legal/nova-9b-license.txt for full terms."

We also need the weight provenance doc: one of {dataset_manifest, training_contract, original_model_checkpoint_link}. Please upload as part of the artifact bundle.

oliver: Great — I'll scope to Dedicated. I'll: (A) re-upload canonical weights and checksum to s3://model-registry/nova/9b/, (B) update tokenizer.json to remap inst token to 320000 and add tokenizer change log, (C) add manifest.json + provenance doc, (D) add attribution header to model_card.md.

rebecca: One more runtime nit — the model_config.yaml currently has: ```model_config.yaml
max_seq_len: 8192
batch_size: 8
kv_cache_dtype: int64
``` Change kv_cache_dtype to int32 and batch_size to 4 for canary. I'll leave a comment on the PR for the config patch.

oliver: Copy — I'll open a PR in model-registry with the updated tokenizer, manifest, and model_card. Tagging @rebecca @jai for review, and @anya for legal ack when the provenance doc is attached.

jai: If you want a quick test script, run this locally to validate tokenizer: ```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(tok.encode('Instruction: do X <|inst|>'))
``` That should not collapse  to stop tokens after patch.

legal-bot: Once PR is up, include the full license txt and provenance link and we'll reply with a short addendum template if the customer asks for Hosted permission.

oliver: Thanks everyone — assigning tasks and will update the thread with PR link. Will keep this Dedicated-only until legal confirms otherwise. :thumbsup:
